story.title: Word Goes Out That They Are Heading East
story.text: Ban Chao had it said everywhere: we are going east.
story.narration: Ban Chao was far away in the western lands, and he wanted the guards to look east. He sent word everywhere: we are marching east! The guards heard it and moved all their soldiers east to watch.

story.title: That Night He Went West
story.text: That very night he slipped away to the west.
story.narration: That night Ban Chao led his men quietly away to the west. The guards were still staring east, where there was nothing at all — and by the time they understood, he was long gone.

keyMoment.question: How do you make the guard look east?

options.text: Put all the bustle on the east side
Shout at him from the east
options.hint: One shout and he knows he is being tricked.
The light is on you — charge and you are seen at once.

keyMoment.reveal: The light looks east; you walk west. Where the bustle is, there the eyes go.

misconceptions: Making a noise in the east is not running about: first draw their eyes away, then take the other side
Wait until they are really looking away before you set off

quiz.question: Ban Chao said he was going east. Where did the enemy move their soldiers?
quiz.explanation: He put all the bustle in the east, so the enemy moved every soldier east to watch.

quiz.question: You want to put a present on the table without your little brother seeing. What do you do?
options: Put his favourite toy on the other side of the room
quiz.explanation: Draw his eyes to the other side and your own job gets done quietly — that is making a noise in the east.
